identification: Golden Fleece 1 pint rectangular tin, late-period livery: orange ram in a blue rounded-shield/trapezoid panel over 'GOLDEN FLEECE' in red on yellow, blue lower band with a BLANK yellow label panel (contents never printed or stamped), '1 PINT / GOLDEN FLEECE PETROLEUM' at the base, small screw cap. 'Golden Fleece Petroleum' wording and the shield logo date it to the late 1960s-1970s (after the H.C. Sleigh 'dogbone' era), so it is the later, less sought livery, not the 1950s ram-on-banner tins. Condition: scratches, small rust spots and grime on yellow, a dark rust/stain smudge below the logo on the second face, rim wear; no dents seen. Estimate 50-70, current bid $30.
